sections.title: Data controller
sections.content: The controller of your data is **{name}**. You can contact me at [{email}](mailto:{email}).

sections.title: What data I collect
sections.content: When you use the contact form I collect your **name**, **email address**, **subject** and **message**. The hosting provider also logs technical data, such as your IP address, to serve and protect the site.

sections.title: How I use it
sections.content: I use your data **only to reply to your message**. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) or my legitimate interest in answering your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). I don't use it to send you marketing.

sections.title: Who else processes it
sections.content: The form is sent through **Formspree** and the site is hosted on **Netlify**. Both act as data processors and only process the data to provide their service. I don't share your data with anyone else.

sections.title: International transfers
sections.content: Formspree and Netlify are based in the **United States**. These transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or, failing that, on the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.

sections.title: How long I keep it
sections.content: I keep your data for as long as needed to handle your enquiry and for **12 months** at most. After that I delete it, including from the Formspree dashboard.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content: You can ask me to access, rectify or erase your data, object to or restrict its processing, or request its portability by writing to [{email}](mailto:{email}). If you think I haven't handled it properly, you can lodge a complaint with the [Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD)](https://www.aepd.es/en).

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
sections.content: This site doesn't use analytics or tracking cookies. It only stores your preferences: a `lang` cookie with your chosen language (1 year) and, in the browser's local storage, the theme (`theme`) and the scroll position when switching languages (`scrollY`).

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.content: If I change this policy, I'll update the date shown at the top of the page.
